name: 48915 · Lansing, MI
findings: ZIP 48915 (Lansing) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48915 (Lansing) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48915 (Lansing) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
